notes.title: Update for older integrated GPUs
notes.notes:
A small patch was rolled out today to address an issue some older laptops with hardware below minimum requirements had. If you think your game looks darker than it should, try turning off the shadows.

Again, this should not happen if your computer meets the current minimum requirements of the game.

Enjoy!
